full_prompt_en: A square graphic fantasy illustration shows a small traveler beside a towering dark giant in a field at an orange sunset. The giant stands on the left, almost reaching the top edge, its enormous torso, long hanging arms, and heavy legs rendered as a rough near-black silhouette. Small projections rise from its head and shoulders, while broken light marks along the edges suggest weathered metal or stone without fully revealing the material. Near the lower center-right, the traveler appears as a much smaller black figure in a short cloak or tunic. One arm lifts near the head, and a narrow object hangs beside the other hand. Dense upright grasses fill the bottom quarter, their many thin dark stems creating a textured base for both figures. A few taller feathery stalks rise around the traveler and at the side edges. Behind them, a huge pale yellow sun sits low on the horizon, its circular edge partly hidden by grass and touched with several curved drawn rings. The sky above shifts from glowing gold near the sun to burnt orange and deep rust overhead, with sparse broad cloudlike strokes. Strong backlight from the low sun makes the figures almost entirely black, with only a few warm edge touches on the giant's limbs. The enormous scale difference makes the open space between the two silhouettes feel tense but deliberate. Details are simplified to bold masses and scratched grass lines; no location markers or readable text compete with the scene. The overall composition is spare and monumental, using a low luminous circle, vertical dark figures, and a limited orange-black palette to suggest an epic encounter.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形图形感奇幻插图呈现一名小旅人，在橙色落日田野里站在高大黑色巨像旁。巨像位于左侧，几乎触到上边，巨大躯干、长垂手臂和沉重双腿被画成粗糙的近黑剪影。头肩处有小型突出结构，边缘的断续亮痕暗示风化金属或石头，却没有完全确定材质。下方中右，一名更小的黑色人物穿短披风或短衣，一只手臂抬到头边，另一只手旁垂着狭窄物件。密集直立草丛填满下方四分之一，许多细深茎为两个人形建立带肌理的基底。几根更高的羽状草穗立在旅人周围及画边。身后，一轮巨大的浅黄色太阳低悬地平线，圆边被草遮去一部分，周围画着数道弯曲环线。上方天空从太阳附近的发亮金色过渡到更高处焦橙与深锈色，只带少量宽阔云状笔痕。低日强逆光使人物几乎全黑，仅在巨像四肢边缘留下少许暖光。极端尺度差让两道剪影间的开放空间紧张而有意。细节简化为大胆体块和刮擦般草线，没有地点标记或可读文字争夺注意。整体构图简洁而雄伟，以低处亮圆、竖立深色人形和受限的橙黑色调暗示史诗般的相遇。
style_prompt_en: The graphic fantasy image uses severe silhouette contrast and a narrow warm palette. A luminous low circle and broad orange-to-rust field backlight dark vertical masses, reducing internal detail to a few rough edge marks. Dense thin strokes form a near-black lower band, while the upper area stays open and relatively flat. Enormous scale differences are made legible by placing small and large forms on the same horizon. Rough brush fragments and scratched contours keep the flat shapes tactile rather than perfectly vector-clean. Light is almost entirely behind the forms, so drama comes from outline and negative space instead of facial detail. The overall effect is spare, monumental, and mythic.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅图形奇幻图像使用严峻剪影对比和狭窄暖色域。发亮的低位圆形与宽阔的橙至锈色场域从后方照亮深色竖向体块，把内部细节压成少量粗糙边缘笔痕。密集细线形成近黑色下方色带，上部则开放且相对平坦。大小悬殊的形体立在同一地平线上，使极端尺度差清楚可辨。粗刷痕碎片和刮擦轮廓让平面形状可触，而非完美干净的矢量。光几乎全在形体后面，因此戏剧性来自外轮廓和负空间，而非面部细节。整体效果简约、雄伟且带神话感。
theme_en: A small traveler beside a towering dark giant at an orange sunset
theme_zh: 橙色落日中，矮小旅人站在高大黑色巨像旁
name: Shadow of the Colossus
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
